use_error_handler_decorator: use the error_handler decorator to wrap functions that may raise AWS, GCP, or Kubernetes exceptions
map_aws_errors: map AWS ClientError exceptions to PcpError subclasses using the error_handler decorator on boto3 calls
map_gcp_errors: map GCP GoogleCloudError exceptions to PcpError subclasses using the error_handler decorator on GCP SDK calls
map_k8s_errors: map Kubernetes OpenApiException errors to PcpError subclasses using the error_handler decorator on k8s client calls
handle_generic_exceptions: wrap any function with error_handler to catch unhandled exceptions and raise them as PcpError
